summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan for making suite-selection-lib.sh resolve a covering suite for source-store paths under any extension, not core alone. Phase 1 adds per-touched-path extension-root resolution threaded through all three strata of _ssl_resolve_one; Phase 2 broadens suite_selection_classify's suite-file lookup across extensions (the ruling on the classification half: extend, not justify core-only); Phase 3 pins the four required behaviours in test-run-all-selection.sh; Phase 4 re-derives the carried 0-of-19 figure and rewrites the header notes; Phase 5 redeploys and runs the suite from both vantage points under the full gate set. The defect was confirmed live during planning: suite_selection_select on the lean path returns __FULL_SWEEP__ although its paired suite exists.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan: extension-aware per-touched-path resolution, broadened classification lookup, four pinning test fixtures, header re-measurement, redeploy plus dual-vantage full-gate verification.
